title: CUTS HEAT vs NITRICOXIDE
directVerdict: CUTS HEAT is the better fit for thermogenic and cutting, while NITRICOXIDE is the better fit for pump.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only CUTS HEAT discloses: L-Carnitine L-Tartrate: 1000 mg per full serving; Taurine: 1000 mg per full serving; Microcrystalline Cellulose: 850 mg per full serving; Potassium Dodecanedioic Acid (Metabolyte): 500 mg per full serving; Chicory Inulin: 500 mg per full serving; Sodium Dodecanedioic Acid (Metabolyte): 400 mg per full serving; Bitter Orange Extract: 160 mg per full serving; ProGBB: 30 mg per full serving.

Only NITRICOXIDE discloses: L-Citrulline: 5 g per full serving; Watermelon Juice Powder: 1 g per full serving; PeakO2 Mushroom Blend: 1 g per full serving; Dextrose: 1 g per full serving; Pink Himalayan Salt: 500 mg per full serving; CitraPeak: 200 mg per full serving; Pine Bark Extract: 180 mg per full serving; Ginkgo Biloba: 120 mg per full serving.
CUTS HEAT caffeine: CUTS HEAT is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine. NITRICOXIDE caffeine: NITRICOXIDE is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: CUTS HEAT: CUTS HEAT: A stimulant-free thermogenic formula positioned for daily consistency and stackability. The easiest concrete points are No disclosed caffeine, L-Carnitine and taurine, Stackable positioning. NITRICOXIDE: NITRICOXIDE: A stimulant-free pre-workout positioned around pump, endurance, and focus through citrulline and extract-based ingredients. The easiest concrete points are 5 g L-Citrulline, PeakO2 and CitraPeak positioning, No disclosed caffeine.
tradeoffs: CUTS HEAT: Customers who specifically want stimulant energy
NITRICOXIDE: Customers asking specifically for stimulant energy
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: CUTS HEAT for thermogenic and cutting; NITRICOXIDE for pump.
